content: Mboomo sumai apamondoa laiana tee alamu tee sagala antona.
I eo pitu eona Aulataʼala padhamo apamondo karajaana ipewauna, tee aponiuntomo Incia i eo pitu eona minaaka i bhari-bharia karajaa ipewauna.
Kasiimpomo, Aulataʼala abarakatimo eo pitu eona sumai tee apekangkilomea, roonamo i eo incia sumaimo Aulataʼala aponiuntomo minaaka i sagala karajaana to apadhaangia dunia ipewauna.
Mboomo sumai tulatulana wakutuuna laiana tee alamu apadhaangiaia. Wakutuuna KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala apadhaangia laiana tee alamu,

bhari-bharia rumpu indapo dhaangia i dunia tee bhari-bharia penembula i tana uka indapo atuwu roonamo KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala indapo apasapo wao i bhawona dunia tee indapo dhaangia mia to mokarajaana tana sumai.
Maka dhaangia o alo apene minaaka i alamu abhaho bhari-bharia bhawona tana.
Wakutuu incia sumai KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala apadhaangia maanusia
minaaka i ngawuna tana tee apoinunca tee ngalu modhadhiakana i nuncana angona. Sumaimo, maanusia sumai amembali mahaluku mokoinyawa.
Maanusia i Inawuna Eden
Kasiimpo, KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala, apewau saangu inawu i Eden,
weta i timbu. Iwe sumaimo Incia apamboorea maanusia padha ipewauna sumai.
Kasiimpo, minaaka i tana, KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala apatuwu manga giuna puuna kau momakesana kamataana tee momalapena motokandena bhakena, tee uka o puuna kau idhadhiaka
i tanga-tangana inawu sumai, tee puuna kau imatauaka to momalapena tee momadhakina.
Minaaka i Eden asiwulu saangu umala to apakouweaka inawu sumai, kasiimpomo minaaka i tampa incia sumai umala apogaa amembali pata solo anana umala.
Sarona umala mobhaa-bhaana Pison. Umala incia sii asiwulu atipua saangua Tana Hawila, tampana bulawa adhaangia.
Bulawa minaaka i tana sumai amalape hasilina. Iwe sumai uka dhaangia garu mawondu tee tundu maali o sarona krisopras.
Sarona umala rua anguna sumai Gihon. Umala incia sii asiwulu atipua saangua Tana Kus.
Sarona umala talu anguna sumai Tigris. Umala incia sii asiwulu i sawetana timbu Asyur. Umala pata anguna sumai Efrat.
KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala, aalamo maanusia sumai tee apamboorea i nuncana Inawu Eden to mokarajaana tee modhambaakana inawu sumai.
Kasiimpomo KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala adhawumo parinta i maanusia sumai, firimanina, "Bhake minaaka bhari-bharia puu i nuncana inawu sii membali ukandea saincamu,
maka bhake minaaka i puu imatauaka to momalapena tee momadhakina siitu bholi ukandea roonamo, i eona ingkoo ukandea, ingkoo dhaanamo umate."
Kasiimpomo KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala afirimani, "Inda malape, maanusia sumai soo samia-miana. Iaku gauku bhekupamembalia samia motulungina incia, mococona tee maanusia sumai."

Sumaimo KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala apewau minaaka i tana sagala binata i koo tee sagala manu-manu i antara, aumbaakea bhari-bharia sumai i maanusia to akamata tuaapa maanusia sumai asarongiakea. Opea uka saro idhawuakana maanusia sumai i manga mahaluku modhadhi, siitumo momembalina sarona.
Kasiimpomo maanusia sumai asarongiakea sagala kadhambaakana, manu-manu i antara, tee sagala binata i koo. Maka to karona samia maanusia sumai inda apotibhaaka samia motulungia mopokanana tee karona.
Sumaimo KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala apewau maanusia sumai atokole mpuu. Tangasaana incia akole, KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala aalamo saangu bukuna kara-karana kasiimpomo atutubhia tampa incia sumai tee dagi.
Minaaka i bukuna kara-karana ialana minaaka i maanusia sumai, KAWASANA OPU Aulataʼala, apamodele samia bhawine, kasiimpo abhawea i maanusia sumai.
Apogaumo maanusia sumai,

content.text: sababuna incia aalea minaaka i umane."

content: Rampaakanamo sumai, samia umane bheabholi amana tee inana to adhadhi apobhawa-bhawa tee bhawinena, sabutuna rua-rua miaia amembali saangu.
Maanusia tee bhawinena sumai rua-rua miaia akalealea, maka manga incia inda anamisi kaea.

footnotes.text: maanusia minaaka i ngawuna tana: Oni "maanusia" tee "tana" i nuncana pogauna Ibrani dhaangiamo oni mopokanana, siitumo Adamu.
Eden: I nuncana pogauna Ibrani, maʼanana "kasanaa."
puuna kau idhadhiaka: Ande o maanusia akande minaaka i puuna kau idhadhiaka, incia bheamboore saʼumurua tee inda amate (Bhaa. 3:22).
puuna kau imatauaka to momalapena tee momadhakina: Puuna kau moumbaakana kakidhana ilahi aharamu to maanusia (Bhaa. 3:22).
Tana Kus: Tana Kus sii dhaangia i lipu Etiopia tee Sudan.
sababuna incia aalea minaaka i umane: I nuncana oni Ibrani, modelena pogau ʼisha  "bhawine" apokana tee modelena pogau ʼish "umane."
